thought.text: Bagus — **pool Indonesia jalan**, dan keluar IP Telkomsel/Indihome asli. Sekarang saya tes apakah bisa "sticky" (IP sama terus), karena itu penting untuk login Google.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && S="stickytest$(date +%s)"; echo "=== sticky session (3x IP harus sama) ==="; for i in 1 2 3; do printf "  %d: " $i; curl -s --max-time 40 -x "http://ResiFactory_1840e2833~id~$S:TPbfq2zsdVHz@premium.resifactory.net:7777" "https://ipinfo.io/json" 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('ip'),d.get('city'),d.get('country'))" 2>/dev/null || echo gagal; sleep 2; done
